evidence_slice: Dartmoor National Park Authority's Authority Monitoring Report 2024/25 identifies Land at New Park, Horrabridge, Proposal 7.9, as an allocation for around 35 homes, 45% affordable, with status updated January 2026: No application made. The official Allocated Site Brief for Proposal 7.9 records a 1.26 hectare site allocated for around 35 homes, with not less than 45% affordable housing. The authority's DCC_Land_Charges_Local_Plan FeatureServer layer 7, Site Allocations: Housing Development, is an esriGeometryPolygon layer supporting GeoJSON with site_name, polcy_ref, settlement and site_area fields; the layer metadata records a data last edit on 12 June 2026.
binding_method: current authority monitoring row plus authority-hosted GeoJSON-capable polygon allocation layer; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: Official AMR, site brief and GIS metadata were accessed through public web transport; raw source-file/query bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash or polygon coordinates are fabricated.
